measurement_scope.apk_size: Exact complete APK file bytes including signing overhead; MB uses 1,000,000 bytes and MiB uses 1,048,576 bytes.
measurement_scope.app_library: libapp.so may change with application code/version; changes are reported and are not an engine-identity failure.
measurement_scope.installed_size: Not measured. APK download bytes exclude extracted JNI libraries, ART files and application data.
measurement_scope.native_packed_size: Sum of compressed native ZIP member payloads; excludes local/central headers and signing overhead.
measurement_scope.negative_saving: A negative saving means the measured APK grew.
measurement_scope.ram_usage: Not measured. Download size or compression does not measure RAM consumption.
measurement_scope.raw_library_identity: SHA-256 of every decompressed native library, streamed without extracting files.
measurement_scope.signatures_and_runtime: Not verified by this helper; use the release verifier and device testing separately.
measurement_scope.variant_comparison: Each standalone APK is compared only to matching architecture libraries in the universal APKs.
